item.title: Jeremy Scheff: My obituary for programming
item.description: A career programmer who loves the puzzle of coding on why agents took the fun — and the leverage — even as they made him faster; surfaced by Simon Willison on Oct 19.

item.title: Kishan Chetan (Salesforce): Personal Agents Will Drive More Contact Center Traffic Than They Offset
item.description: Personal agents never tire of hold music — they redial, parallel-call providers and check at 2 a.m., so peak call volume becomes the norm; vendor-flavored and data-free, but the mechanism is real.
